Read the fields of identifiers

Source: R/fields.R
id_fields.Rd

id_fields() reports what each identifier carries, one row per element. id_time() returns its time field alone, and id_version() its version.

Usage

id_fields(x)

id_time(x, class = c("POSIXct", "ms"))

id_version(x)

Arguments

x

A zuid vector from id_parse().

class

For id_time(), "POSIXct" (the default), or "ms" for the whole number of milliseconds since 1970 as a double, the sub-millisecond part dropped. POSIXct is exact to the microsecond; the 100 ns ticks of UUID versions 1 and 6 are exact in neither.

Value

id_fields(): a data frame with columns format, time, time_unit, version, variant, node, process, sequence, random, prefix, codec, hash, digest and numbers, NA where the format or the element has no such field. id_time(): a POSIXct in UTC or a double. id_version(): an integer vector.

Details

For a UUID, the fields depend on the version and are read only when the variant is RFC 9562's:

  • versions 1 and 6: the time in 100 ns ticks from 1582-10-15, the 14-bit clock sequence (sequence) and the 48-bit node;

  • version 4: the 122 random bits;

  • version 7: the millisecond time and the 74 random bits;

  • versions 2, 3, 5 and 8: the version only.

A ULID has its millisecond time and 80 random bits. A TypeID has its UUID's fields and its prefix, "" when it has none. A UPID has its time in 256 ms units, 64 random bits, its prefix and its version nibble (6, the reference's "a", is the current one).

The nil and max UUIDs report versions 0 and 15 and no variant. random is the random bits joined in order, as hex, left-padded with zero bits to a whole number of hex digits.

Examples

x <- id_parse(c(
  "018f6b1c-2d3e-7a4b-8c5d-6e7f8091a2b3",
  "c232ab00-9414-11ec-b3c8-9f6bdeced846"
), "uuid")
id_fields(x)
#>   format                time time_unit version variant         node process
#> 1   uuid 2024-05-12 04:42:39        ms       7     rfc         <NA>      NA
#> 2   uuid 2022-02-22 19:22:22     100ns       1     rfc 9f6bdeced846      NA
#>   sequence              random prefix codec hash digest numbers
#> 1       NA 292cc5d6e7f8091a2b3   <NA>  <NA> <NA>   <NA>        
#> 2    13256                <NA>   <NA>  <NA> <NA>   <NA>        
id_time(x)
#> [1] "2024-05-12 04:42:39 UTC" "2022-02-22 19:22:22 UTC"
id_version(x)
#> [1] 7 1
